description: This Java source file defines a specific exception class, TooManyRequestsException, which is a custom runtime exception used in the context of handling HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a nested builder class for flexible object construction.

classes.name: TooManyRequestsException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when too many requests are made in a short period, such as via WebSocket connection, returning HTTP 429 status.
